title: NY Harbor Fishing

services.name: NYC Fishing
services.desc: Join Captain Joe and Captain Hunter for a hands-on fishing trip in New York Harbor, ideal for first-timers, children, and experienced anglers alike. The crew provides all rods, reels, lures, bait, life jackets in sizes from infant to adult, and foul-weather gear, so you can focus on fishing and sightseeing. Trips offer views of the Statue of Liberty and city skylines day or night, and the captains combine decades of local experience to deliver a safe, fun, and memorable outing on a boat that carries up to four people. You can select the duration of 2 hours, 3 hours, 4.5 hours, or an 8 hour trip! Please Note: Operator presence on trips - Captain Joe and Captain Hunter run the trips! Gift
